usedFor: CTM tracks your calls, and Freshsales Classic receives a deal when “Call Ends” runs “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “Call Ends” in CTM, then “Create Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: Waiting for the call to end means the deal starts from a finished conversation, with the caller as contact.

watchOut: Using both “Call Ends” and “New Call Starts” with “Create Deal” opens two deals for one call.
